insight: Founded as Hiretual; rebranded to hireEZ — pronounced 'hire easy' — in Feb 2022 alongside an oversubscribed $26M Series B.
name: hireEZ
tagline: Agentic AI recruiting platform that sits on your ATS.
description: Outbound recruiting platform that sources, screens, engages, and schedules candidates with AI agents layered on top of whatever ATS a team already runs. Its EZ Agent searches 750M+ candidate profiles across 45+ open-web platforms, screens applicants, and automates outreach and interview scheduling. Built for recruiting teams that want passive-candidate discovery without replacing their stack.
edge: Layers AI sourcing onto your existing ATS (Workday, Greenhouse, iCIMS) instead of forcing teams to replace their stack.

references.title: HireEZ, formerly Hiretual, raises $26M to expand its platform
